name: Easy Slow Cooker Vegan Tofu Tikka Masala with Mixed Veggies & Naan

ingredients.name: vegetable medley (baby carrots, broccoli and cauliflower florets)

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Place in a 6-quart slow cooker insert along with tomato sauce, coconut milk, ginger paste, garlic, and spices. Stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium yellow onion
639 ml tomato sauce
760 ml coconut milk
1 tbsp ginger paste
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 tbsp garam masala
2 tsp cumin, ground
1 tsp salt
½ tsp cardamom, ground

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice tofu. Add to the slow cooker, along with veggies, and stir to combine the tikka masala. Cover and cook until warmed through and flavors have blended, 5-6 hours on LOW or HIGH for 3-4 hours.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (340 g) bag vegetable medley (baby carrots, broccoli and cauliflower florets)

instructions.primary_message: When the tikka masala is done, add peas to the insert and stir to combine. Continue to cook until warmed through, 10-15 minutes more.
Meanwhile, toast naan if desired, then cut into wedges.
Divide tikka masala between bowls. Serve with naan on the side and enjoy!
